# proxy-tools 0.1.0

Bundled in the macOS app as a dependency of pywebview. It is installed from
`proxy_tools-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`, which is recorded by digest in `installer/bundle/built_wheels.json`. That wheel
was built from the PyPI sdist `proxy_tools-0.1.0.tar.gz`, sha256
`ccb3751f529c047e2d8a58440d86b205303cf0fe8146f784d1cbcd94f0a28010`. The package itself is unmodified.

- **License of the package:** MIT, as declared in its package metadata. The sdist ships no license file.
- **Origin of the code:** the module's own docstring says it was extracted from Werkzeug, which is
  distributed under the BSD-3-Clause license below.
